facts.value: The net online tuition price provides a better estimate of how much money you’ll actually spend on your college degree. It is calculated by subtracting any college financial aid such as grants, scholarships, tuition waivers, and other types of federal aid from the cost of tuition and fees.
ASU is ranked #2 in the U.S. for employability among public universities.
ASU has a team of support available to help navigate the complexities of paying for college, including assistance with scholarship opportunities and filling out the FAFSA.

Students can call to speak with an enrollment coach about financial aid, email an enrollment coach with tuition and financial aid questions, visit one of ASU's four campus locations to speak with a financial aid advisor in person, or use live chat to speak with financial aid advisors if they are already admitted to ASU.
